claims.statement: The bot-turn pipeline mirrors the LangGraph topology 1:1: load_conversation_state → typing → agent → fast_safety_filter → needs_llm_safety? → (yes → llm_safety_check → safe_to_send? → retry_rewrite at most once) → combine_for_presend → pre_send_guard → ownership_ok? → send_message/log_sent.

GraphDeps (backend/app/graph/types.py) is the typed injection container; ports in graph/ports.py are Protocols so the runner is unit-testable with fakes and only factories.build_deps constructs concrete services.

_build_cached_clients caches LLM clients + embedder keyed only by the integration_minimax and integration_openrouter cache versions, deliberately excluding Zalo, so an OA token rotation never tears down the cached LLM clients.

Per-turn GraphDeps wires the agent (MiniMaxAgent wrapping agent_llm + embedder + fast_llm), the per-turn ZaloChannelSender with refresh closure, OA profile enrichment isolated on its own DB session, and a parallel-tool-dispatch make_retrieval factory so concurrent tool calls get isolated sessions and never share the primary db.

Settings.bot_lock_ttl_seconds defaults to 180 s and the RQ job timeout is set below it so RQ kills a runaway turn before the lock expires; the webhook acquires the lock with an owner token, the worker passes lock_owner through BotRunState, and run_turn re-checks ownership via svc.recheck_ownership(conv, version_at_start, lock_owner).

Three locks gate the turn: reactive ownership (lock_owner_lost) closes the recheck→send TOCTOU; runtime stamp suppression (stale_runtime_authority / missing_runtime_policy / inactive_runtime_policy / missing_runtime_authority) ensures a clean cutover never lets pre-authority jobs inherit today's capabilities; claim_send atomically transitions PENDING→SENDING and suppresses on rowcount 0.

OA profile enrichment runs only after ownership validation, with a strict ceiling of min(OA_PROFILE_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, max(0, deadline_remaining - settings.soft_fallback_remaining)) so a slow OA response never pins the answer budget; persistence_low remains the eventual-consistency fallback.

Outbound errors are classified into SENT, SUPPRESSED, SEND_UNKNOWN (error_class in AMBIGUOUS_SEND_CLASSES — non-retriable, reconciler keeps the row for audit), or FAILED (reconciler may re-enqueue); the AMBIGUOUS_SEND_CLASSES set is shared with the outbound dispatcher tick.

DecisionTraceBuilder is allocated at the start of run_turn, accumulates per-branch decisions via record_decision, snapshots at claim_send time, and persists via BotRun.decision_trace JSONB; per-stage timings flow into BotRun.stage_timings and feed the performance dashboard.
